title: Multiplicity One and van Dijk's Conjecture for Connected Complex Symmetric Spaces
summary: We prove regularity for symmetric pairs of connected complex reductive groups by combining invariant theory with the analysis of Schwartz distributions. For the classical residual families, a Gaussian lifting argument reduces the required equivariant vanishing to invariant theory in quadratic moment quotients: contraction and supertrace identities settle DIII and balanced CII, while Gram-matrix invariants and volume tensors handle BDI/Spin.
